prompt: Which advice should the support editor give about the display-case records?
promptZh: 關於展示品箱的紀錄，支援編輯應提供哪項建議？

options.text: The branch’s stock did not change overall; use Branch Summary again with only this branch selected to show when each movement happened.
options.zh: 分店庫存總量未變；再用「分店摘要」只選這間分店，就能看到每筆異動發生時間。
options.whyZh: 庫存總量未變的解讀可以成立，但摘要即使只選一間分店也不列個別異動，因此不能顯示每筆時間。

options.text: The branch’s stock did not change overall, but two movements were recorded; use Movement Detail without combining stock codes to show both.
options.zh: 分店庫存總量未變，但有兩筆異動紀錄；請用「異動明細」，不要按品號合併，就能分別顯示。
options.whyZh: 「無變動」是庫存的淨結果，不等於沒發生異動。兩筆編號不同但品號相同的異動需分列；關閉品號合併才能保留兩列。

options.text: Two movements were recorded; use Movement Detail with stock-code combining on to retain a separate row for each movement reference.
options.zh: 有兩筆異動紀錄；請用「異動明細」，開啟品號合併，以便依各異動編號保留各自的一列。
options.whyZh: 兩筆不同異動的判斷正確，但開啟合併後是按品號併列，並非保留每個異動編號。

options.text: ‘No change’ rules out any real movement; check the source records to see which of the two references was copied in error.
options.zh: 「無變動」代表沒有實際的異動；查看原始紀錄，找出哪個異動編號是誤抄的。
options.whyZh: 摘要的「無變動」只表示淨結果，不能否定已記下的出庫和入庫，也沒有證據顯示其中一筆是誤抄。

explanationZh: 「無變動」是庫存的淨結果，不等於沒發生異動。兩筆編號不同但品號相同的異動需分列；關閉品號合併才能保留兩列。
evidence: Its optional “Combine identical stock codes” setting merges moves for the same item instead. / a branch’s total reflects the change in its stock, not the number of movements. / the overview displays ‘No change’ even if the branch has entries in Movement Detail. / Stores logged a case going out and a case of the same stock code coming back, with separate movement references. / took it to mean nobody moved the stock.

vocabulary.note: 開啟後，匯出報表會合併同一商品代碼的異動，不再逐筆顯示。
